editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Markets.com is a CySEC/ASIC-regulated broker scoring 6.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. Variable spreads from 0.6 pips with zero commission on 2,200+ instruments. Simple, user-friendly platform. Limited by the absence of raw ECN pricing, aggressive inactivity fee, and the 73% retail loss rate. Best for casual CFD traders wanting simplicity over raw cost efficiency.
